candidate.derivedAnswer: D. Randomly select students from the entire school
candidate.answerReason: School-wide random selection avoids the systematic restrictions by team membership, grade, or height imposed by the other choices.

methods.label: Compare sampling bias
methods.explanation: Random selection gives every student an equal chance of being selected, helping avoid systematic selection bias, although an individual sample may still be unrepresentative by chance. The other methods restrict selection by team membership, grade, or height and risk bias. Therefore, choose D.
methods.levelReason: Judging representativeness and selection bias uses Grade 7 sampling concepts within the Grade 8 scope.
